rationale: Sofiya brings deep data science expertise from Fractal Analytics while Nitesh leads infrastructure and DevOps at Cloudera—a natural pairing for building scalable data platforms. His hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure tools (Terraform, cloud DevOps) and backend systems complements her data science focus, making them well-positioned to discuss modern data stack architecture and infrastructure challenges.
intro_message: Sofiya Mujawar, meet Nitesh — you're both working at the intersection of data and infrastructure, and could compare notes on scaling data systems across cloud environments.
